_why: Ranges the frontal-face test cannot see, read off contact sheets of the CUT files. Two blind spots it has: a face in profile (a bench chat filmed side-on), and an interruption with no face in it at all (a sponsor read that cuts to close-ups of a book). Times are seconds into the SOURCE file in data/incoming. Boundaries are padded a few seconds because --fast stream copy snaps the start back to the nearest keyframe.
